538:t_3:29.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Heh heh... $$キリコ$$... Their presence seems to have influenced how you live too.」

538:t_3:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「Of course it has. $$キリコ$$ is part of $c too.」

538:t_3:32.en:
$$スザク$$
「What will you do now, $$キリコ$$?」

538:t_3:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You recovered $$フィアナ$$ and defeated $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, the being who twisted your fate. Your battle ends here...」

538:t_3:35.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Even if my battle is over, $c's battle is not.」

538:t_3:36.en:
$$キリコ$$
「No... As long as my battle with $c continues, my own battle will not end.」

538:t_3:40.en:
$$カレン$$
「Of course you're more than welcome!」

538:t_3:41.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「What will you do about $$フィアナ$$?」

538:t_3:42.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「If you like, I can take her into my care.」

538:t_3:43.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I will not hand $$フィアナ$$ over to an irresponsible gawker.」

538:t_3:44.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「...I thought you would say that.」

538:t_3:45.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「You would not be $$キリコ・キュービィー$$ if you relied on me here.」

538:t_3:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「We know just the people for that. I've contacted $$ゴウト$$ and the others.」

538:t_3:47.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The Southeast Asian front's rough too, but the $$ＥＸ－１０$$ guys are there. I'm sure they'll protect $$フィアナ$$.」

538:t_3:48.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I will owe them another favor.」

538:t_3:49.en:
$$マオ$$
「You don't have to worry about that. They were crying with joy.」

538:t_3:50.en:
$$クルツ$$
「They sure love you and $$フィアナ$$.」

538:t_3:52.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is good timing. Let us ask the unit bringing Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ here to transport $$フィアナ$$.」

538:t_3:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We received word a little while ago. She alone will join us for the next operation.」

538:t_3:55.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$キリコ$$... It will be brief, but spend the time until then with her.」

538:t_3:60.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Amid my comrades' congratulations, I thought about what $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ meant by a future of despair...)

538:t_3:61.en:
$$キリコ$$
(But no one knows the future. Then we should be able to turn despair into hope.)

538:t_3:62.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Now that I knew $$フィアナ$$ was alive, a light had been born within me.)

538:t_3:63.en:
$$キリコ$$
(To protect it, I could keep fighting... Today... and tomorrow...)

538:t_10:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「What is that, $$ＡＧ$$!? What are you holding!?」

538:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What do you mean...? As you can see, it's a bunny suit.」

538:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To celebrate settling things with $$カン・ユー$$ and look back on your history with him, I'd really like you to wear this...」

538:t_10:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

538:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(This is bad... She's five seconds away from completely losing her temper...)

538:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-anyway, your anger at $$カン・ユー$$ produced 100Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

538:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, I... will be taking my leave...」

538:t_10:13.en:
$$カレン$$
「Leaving that bunny suit with you is asking for trouble. I'll take it... as compensation for everything you've put me through.」

538:t_10:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「What should I do with it...? Maybe I'll wear it if we have a party...」

538:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems you actually liked it more than expected.」

538:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, $$シャッコ$$. You splendidly fulfilled your duty as a hero of $$クエント$$.」

538:t_10:26.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「This is a good opportunity to tell you. You have the same smell as $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

538:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... take more care over my fragrance than anyone... any robot, I mean...」

538:t_10:28.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Do not evade the question.」

538:t_10:30.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「But I am like $$クロウ$$. Somewhere inside, part of me trusts you.」

538:t_10:32.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「So do not do anything to betray us.」

538:t_10:34.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「You can promise that, can't you?」

538:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I can! Trust is a treasure in business!」

538:t_10:36.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I still feel uneasy, though...」

538:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At times like that, let's get fired up and blow away those doubts! Let's get going today too...!」

538:t_10:40.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Somehow I feel as though I've been skillfully talked around...」

539:t_000:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh, wow! They even restored the cathedral properly!」

539:t_000:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's not something the guy who wrecked it should say.」

539:t_000:3.en:
$$ボビー$$
「So in the end, they wouldn't agree to talks beforehand.」

539:t_000:4.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「To them, $c committed the $$赫い霍乱$$. It is only to be expected.」

539:t_000:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Telling them they kidnapped $$フィアナ$$ and caused chaos around the world probably won't help.」

539:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「To His Holiness Pope $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ of the $$マーティアル$$ Church. This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$ of $c.」

539:t_000:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As we stated in our prior message, we request an audience to speak with you.」

539:t_001:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Their defense force has come out!」

539:t_001:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Look! $$ファイヤバグ$$ is here too!」

539:t_001:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「It seems $$マーティアル$$ still has covert ties to $$アマルガム$$.」

539:t_001:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So that is why they attacked us on $$神根島$$...」

539:t_001:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We have no choice. Launch the mobile task force.」
